command:
set -euo pipefail
export LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 GALLIUM_DRIVER=llvmpipe XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== write the render script (Wavelet -> Contour -> PNG); nothing is staged =="
cat > render.py <<'EOF'
from paraview.simple import (Wavelet, Contour, GetActiveViewOrCreate, Show,
    ColorBy, GetDisplayProperties, Render, SaveScreenshot, servermanager)
import sys
wavelet = Wavelet()
contour = Contour(Input=wavelet, ContourBy=["POINTS","RTData"], Isosurfaces=[150.0])
contour.UpdatePipeline()
di = servermanager.Fetch(contour)
print("CONTOUR_POINTS", di.GetNumberOfPoints())
print("CONTOUR_CELLS", di.GetNumberOfCells())
view = GetActiveViewOrCreate("RenderView"); view.ViewSize=[400,300]
Show(contour, view); ColorBy(GetDisplayProperties(contour,view), ("POINTS","RTData"))
Render(); SaveScreenshot(sys.argv[-1], view)
EOF

echo "== headless render: Xvfb + llvmpipe GLX, no GPU, no display =="
Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
XVFB=$!
for i in $(seq 1 200); do [ -S /tmp/.X11-unix/X99 ] && break; sleep 0.05; done
export DISPLAY=:99
pvbatch /tmp/render.py /tmp/render.png > pvbatch.out 2>&1 || true
kill "$XVFB" 2>/dev/null || true
grep -E "CONTOUR_" pvbatch.out || true

python3 - <<'PY' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import re, os, sys
fail=[]
def check(label, ok, detail):
    print(f"{label:24s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(label)
out=open("/tmp/pvbatch.out").read()
cp=re.search(r"CONTOUR_POINTS (\d+)", out); cc=re.search(r"CONTOUR_CELLS (\d+)", out)
cp_val=int(cp.group(1)) if cp else -1; cc_val=int(cc.group(1)) if cc else -1
check("contour_points", cp_val==3034, f"{cp_val}  want exactly 3034 (flying-edges isosurface)")
check("contour_cells",  cc_val==5768, f"{cc_val}  want exactly 5768")
from PIL import Image
path="/tmp/render.png"
check("png_exists", os.path.isfile(path) and os.path.getsize(path)>1000,
      f"{os.path.getsize(path) if os.path.isfile(path) else 0} B  want > 1000")
im=Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
check("png_size", im.size==(400,300), f"{im.size}  want (400, 300)")
colors=im.getcolors(10**6); ncol=len(colors) if colors else 0
check("real_geometry", ncol>50, f"{ncol} distinct colours  want > 50 (published D3: 796)")
dominant=max(c for c,_ in colors)/120000.0 if colors else 1.0
check("not_blank", dominant<0.98, f"{dominant:.1%} one colour  want < 98% (geometry drew)")
lo,hi=im.convert("L").getextrema()
check("luminance_range", hi-lo>40, f"{lo}..{hi}  want range > 40")
if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
PY
cat smoke-check.txt
test -s /tmp/render.png
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
